title: Jamaican Tofu Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy stir fry featuring marinated tofu and a blend of Jamaican herbs. Serve over rice or noodles for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Marinate the tofu in light soy sauce, olive oil, and Jamaican herbs for at least 30 minutes.
Heat a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and bell pepper and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Add the marinated tofu and stir-fry for another 3-4 minutes, until golden brown.
Add the stir fry sauce and stir-fry for 1 minute, until the sauce is bubbly and slightly thickened.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
